verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack ties Devin to security-alert ingestion (e.g., from SAST/DAST/dependency scanners), automated validation of such alerts, or auto-generated remediation PRs tied to those alerts; docs only describe general task delegation (tickets, bugs, features) and generic PR/session capabilities, not a security-alert-specific workflow. missing for 10: integration with security scanners/alert sources, evidence of alert triage/validation logic, and documented auto-PR remediation flow for vulnerabilities.
